item.title: Riders Extend All-cfl Guard Jacob Brammer
item.description: The Saskatchewan Roughriders have signed American offensive lineman Jacob Brammer to a one-year contract extension. item.title: Roughriders Ink 2023 Sun Belt Conference Player Of The Year Qb Jordan Mccloud
item.description: The Saskatchewan Roughriders have signed American quarterback Jordan McCloud. item.title: Lokombo Returns For 6th Season In Green And White
item.description: The Saskatchewan Roughriders have signed National defensive back Nelson Lokombo to a contract extension.
